current_sources: Measurement tables read from each plate's database and merged into one analysis frame. Supported tables are registered object roles, including organelles, and png_list. For tabular Classify, choose a nonempty list of distinct supported tables with at least one object-role table. Default ['cell', 'nucleus', 'pathogen', 'cytoplasm'].
retired_sources: Measurement tables read from each plate's database and merged into one analysis frame. Only 'cell', 'nucleus', 'pathogen', 'cytoplasm', and 'png_list' are merged. Any other table, including 'organelle', is loaded but omitted from the merged result without a warning. Default ['cell', 'nucleus', 'pathogen', 'cytoplasm'].
